strategy.title: A Pattern in Time Hiding in Plain Sight
strategy.hook: Once you notice this repeating pattern in time, ordinary scenes become evidence.

story_structure.opening: Show three apparently unrelated scenes where time appears.
story_structure.escalation: Overlay the shared pattern so the connection becomes visually undeniable.
story_structure.takeaway: Give viewers one observation prompt they can use to spot the pattern themselves.

strategy.audience: Curious learners who save and share clear visual explanations.
strategy.visual_direction: Three everyday vignettes linked by one repeating geometry for time; subtle-to-bright pattern reveal, unified color cue, discovery-focused composition
